//: Lighthouse CI budgets. Used by .github/workflows/ci.yml (a REAL gate — accessibility asserts as an error). Serves the static build with `serve` (clean URLs on, so /404 maps to 404.html) and audits EVERY fixed route — the same list as tests/routes.ts; keep the two in sync when a fixed page ships. Dynamic [slug] detail routes are excluded: the CI empty-env build emits none. Desktop preset matches the project's desktop target. Performance stays a warning because CI runners vary. Run locally: npm run build && npx --yes @lhci/cli@0.14.x autorun (note: on Windows lhci can exit 1 on an EPERM temp-cleanup crash AFTER all audits passed — read the assertion results, not the exit code).
